question: Discuss the factors that determine the working capital requirement of a business.
sources: Management of working capital: determinants of working capital requirement

points.label: Nature and size of business
points.description: Trading and manufacturing firms need more working capital than service firms; larger firms need more in absolute terms.
points.basis: Working capital: nature and scale of business

points.label: Production and operating cycle
points.description: A longer production process and operating cycle ties up more funds in inventory and receivables.
points.basis: Working capital: length of operating cycle

points.label: Credit policy
points.description: Liberal credit to customers raises working capital needs; credit received from suppliers reduces them.

points.label: Seasonal and business conditions
points.description: Seasonal businesses need more working capital in peak season; boom and growth raise needs, recession lowers them.
points.basis: Working capital: seasonality, growth and business cycle

points.label: Inventory policy and efficiency
points.description: Policies on stock levels, availability of raw materials and efficient operations affect how much is needed.
points.basis: Working capital: inventory policy and operating efficiency
